question: Which of the following teams won the 86th Ranji Trophy title in March 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Saurashtra.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Saurashtra **won the 86th **Ranji Trophy Title by defeating Bengal. **
 
• It was played between 9 to 13 March 2020 in Saurashtra Cricket
